prompt: A CardLayout deck holds three named cards. Complete getVisibleCardName so it reports which card is showing, and showCard so it jumps straight to a card by name and refreshes the label.
explanation: CardLayout does not remove the hidden cards -- it keeps every one of them in the container and simply toggles visibility, so exactly one child ever reports isVisible() as true. That makes "which card is showing" a question you answer by scanning deck.getComponents(), not by tracking an index of your own that could drift out of step. cards.show(deck, name) needs the container passed back in because one CardLayout instance is only meaningful together with the container it manages.
hints: Loop over deck.getComponents() with an enhanced for and test each component's isVisible().
Return the component's getName(); the cards were given names that match their card names.
showCard is two lines: cards.show(deck, name) followed by refresh().
